steps.en: Officer searches for notices under one ID
steps.id: Officer mencari notice di bawah satu ID
steps.why_en: Search by ID exists but is not limited to outstanding warrants.
steps.why_id: Pencarian by ID ada tapi tidak dibatasi ke warrant outstanding.

steps.en: Results show outstanding-warrant notices to select
steps.id: Hasil menampilkan notice warrant outstanding untuk dipilih
steps.why_en: Results do not show warrant status or allow selecting many notices.
steps.why_id: Hasil tidak menampilkan status warrant atau pilihan banyak notice.

steps.en: Officer enters one remark for all selected notices
steps.id: Officer mengisi satu remark untuk semua notice terpilih
steps.why_en: Only a single-notice remark field exists, and it is not reachable.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada kolom remark satu notice dan tidak bisa diakses.

steps.en: OCMS applies the remark to all selected notices at once
steps.id: OCMS menerapkan remark ke semua notice terpilih sekaligus

steps.en: The remark is saved for every selected notice
steps.id: Remark tersimpan untuk setiap notice terpilih
